messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary alert for service `embedder` (us-west-2). 5xx rate 12% over 5m, p95 latency 1.8s. Canary release roll 2026-03-15 commit ab12cd3. Auto-abort did not trigger. Please investigate and advise next action.

maria: on it. paging oncall. tagging @alec since he queued this rollout.

alec: yep i pushed the canary, i'm seeing the same graph. quick look shows a new mem spike in the worker process after the new tokenizer change.

jen: can we hit the feature-flag kill-switch for the new tokenizer first? that should be instant and minimal blast radius.

alec: flag is `ff/encoder/new-tokenizer`. I can toggle but want ops to coordinate if we need quick revert.

ops-ana: ready to flip. if ff rollback doesn't clear, we should revert commit ab12cd3 and hotpatch production. which do we want first?

maria: try kill-switch first. low risk. if metrics don't fall in 3 mins -> revert. kevin on-call in 20, i'm still here to triage for 10.

ops-ana: toggling flag now:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/flags/ff/encoder/new-tokenizer/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag `ff/encoder/new-tokenizer` set to false by ops-ana.

maria: monitoring...

(alec): small improvement on errors but still ~6% 5xx. latency trending down slightly.

support-liz: I'm seeing a handful of support tickets: customers A and C reporting embedding timeouts. low volume but high severity for them. adding to internal IC notes.

jen: OK plan B: revert commit ab12cd3. we should do a single-commit revert and push hotfix. i'll prepare the revert PR but ops can run the hotpatch if we need faster path.

ops-ana: I can run hotpatch now using the emergency rollback script. last check - is ab12cd3 the exact bad commit?

alec: yes. verified locally. revert command:
```
git fetch origin main && git revert --no-edit ab12cd3 && git push origin HEAD:hotfix/revert-ab12cd3
# then trigger hotpatch
./deploy/scripts/hotpatch.sh --branch hotfix/revert-ab12cd3 --service embedder --env prod --priority high
```

maria: go for it, ops-ana. i'll watch the dashboards and coordinate comms. tagging @kevin for handoff in 10.

ops-ana: running hotpatch now. logs: `starting hotpatch -> pushing hotfix branch -> invoking canary deploy (2 instances)`

deploy-bot: Hotpatch deploy started: hotfix/revert-ab12cd3 -> canary instances: embedder-prod-canary-2 -> expected stable in ~3m.

ops-ana: canary logs show successful startup. no new OOMs.

maria: 1m after canary: 5xx down to 1.5% and p95 back to baseline 400ms. continuing to monitor for full rollout.

support-liz: updating affected tickets: small customer cohort impacted (approx 2% of requests), advising workaround where possible.

kevin: taking over on-call. handoff: root cause likely tokenizer mem growth introduced in ab12cd3, FF toggle mitigated partially, hotpatch revert rolled back change. I'll keep an eye for regressions and follow-up with a proper patch+test. maria handing off incident docs.

maria: handing off incident to kevin. summary:
- cause: tokenizer change in ab12cd3 causing mem growth on embedder workers
- mitigation: toggled ff/encoder/new-tokenizer -> partial improvement; performed hotpatch revert of ab12cd3 -> restored baseline
- customer impact: ~2% of requests affected, handful of support tickets (A/C) opened, no data loss
- next steps: write postmortem, add unit/regression test for tokenizer mem behavior, consider gradual rollout gates for heavy infra changes

kevin: noted. I've increased alert sensitivity on mem and deployed a temp probe for embedder p95. will start a follow-up ticket to require perf bench numbers in PRs that touch encoders.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Hotpatch completed and promoted to prod (rollback successful). Canary and prod metrics stable for 5m.

maria: closing active response. tagging @all - please add any missing context to the incident doc. great coordination. :thumbsup:

support-liz: will follow up with customers and mark tickets for postmortem notes.

alec: thanks everyone. will open the PR with extra tests and a repro.

kevin: putting this incident into my oncall notes and starting the postmortem draft.

maria: handing off final: kevin has it. i'm off for meetings.

kevin: acknowledged.
